finding: 600000: 2146 daily rows, 2018-01-02..2026-11-09. Raw API count is also 2146, so this sample is not truncated at SDK pageSize 5000.
limitation: No 2015-2017 coverage in this sample. Only one stock probed. Financial disclosure timing and historical restatements are not documented by the observed response. The SDK fetches only page 1; validate total count for each security. Filter observations after task end date.

finding: 7502 dated old/new abbreviation events, 1994-01-03..2026-11-06. 2284 rows contain ST in before or after names. 208 of 212 delisted securities have at least one name event.
limitation: Shenzhen only; includes B shares and ordinary name changes. An ST interval prototype requires event ordering, exchange-specific A-share filtering, effective-date checks, and coverage evidence. No events does not prove never ST. Does not close Shanghai/Beijing gap. Current security abbreviation column must not be backfilled historically.

finding: 161 returned rows with listing date and upstream DELIST_DATE. SDK labels DELIST_DATE as 暂停上市日期 despite requesting COMPANY_STATUS=3 from the delisting source.
limitation: symbol=全部 includes A/B/STAR type selection; filter A shares explicitly. Inspect raw upstream semantics before normalizing delist_date. A single current delisted list plus current live list does not by itself prove complete listing episodes, code changes or relistings. SDK hardcodes pageSize 500/page 1.

finding: 212 terminated-listing securities, listing dates 1990-12-01..2022-07-08 and termination dates 1999-07-12..2026-10-28.
limitation: Contains B shares. Must distinguish listing episodes and include delisted price/adjustment coverage before claiming no survivorship bias. Include only universe intervals relevant to task dates.

finding: date=20151221 returned 3738 records, 3723 with stop starts after 2015-12-21, including 2026-11-10. Raw API reproduces same count and future events.
limitation: The supplied date is not a reliable exact-day snapshot filter. Do not label every returned security suspended on requested date or infer non-suspension from absence. Actual end time and predicted resume date are distinct; future-known end data must not be used as an ex ante signal.

finding: 600000, requested 2010-01-01..2025-12-31: five records, each a different classification standard, 2019-05-08..2024-02-08. Shenwan record starts 2021-07-30.
limitation: These five records are not one continuous industry timeline. No record establishes a 2015/2018 baseline in any chosen standard. SDK drops latest-record marker. Do not retroactively fill older dates or mix classifications. Further source completeness and revision checks required.

limitation: Contents, coverage, in/out history and point-in-time meaning not verified. Latest classification under a 2021 taxonomy cannot automatically be treated as the classification known in 2015.
